hero.eyebrow: Kitchen & bath remodeling in Plano, TX
hero.headline: A kitchen or bathroom remodel in Plano, without the runaround.
hero.subhead: Kitchen remodels, bathroom remodels and home additions for homeowners in Plano and the north Dallas suburbs. Tell us about the job and get a written estimate you can compare line by line.

skyeGreeting: Hi, I'm Skye, the assistant for Tallow Creek Remodeling. Planning a kitchen, bathroom or addition? Tell me about it and I'll help you get an estimate or book a time.

about.headline: You enjoy your home. We handle the remodeling work properly.
about.body: Most homeowners we talk to want the same three things: a clear price before anything starts, a crew that shows up when it says it will, and a house that's still livable while the work happens. Every remodel is planned around those.

cards.title: Busy families
cards.body: A kitchen that works for weeknight dinners, finished with as little disruption to the house as possible.

cards.title: Getting ready to sell
cards.body: Kitchen and bathroom updates that help the house show well, scoped to what buyers notice.

cards.title: Growing households
cards.body: An extra bedroom, sunroom or second story, framed and finished to match the rest of the house.

about.closing: Not sure where to start? Tell us what you're thinking and we'll talk it through.

problems.headline: Finding a reliable remodeler in Plano shouldn't be this hard.

points.title: Unreturned calls & slow estimates
points.body: You leave messages, wait a week, and still don't have a number to plan around.

points.title: Vague pricing & surprise costs
points.body: A one-line quote that turns into change orders once the walls are open.

points.title: Missed timelines
points.body: Start dates slip, trades don't turn up, and the kitchen stays out of action for weeks.

points.title: Messy job sites
points.body: Dust through the house and debris left in the driveway at the end of the day.

problems.bridge: You shouldn't have to chase a contractor just to get a clear estimate.

solutions.headline: Straightforward remodeling built around clear communication.

services.title: Kitchen remodels
services.body: New cabinets, countertops, plumbing and lighting, from a layout change to a full gut and rebuild.

services.title: Bathroom remodels
services.body: Walk-in showers, tub-to-shower conversions, tile, vanities and new fixtures.

services.title: Home additions
services.body: Extra bedrooms, sunrooms and second-story additions, framed and finished to match the house.

process.headline: We listen to what you need. Estimate it clearly. Build it right.

steps.title: Request your estimate
steps.body: Send a few details with the form or give us a call. A ZIP code and a rough idea is plenty.

steps.title: Site visit & clear scope
steps.body: We look at the space, talk through options and put the scope and price in writing.

steps.title: Clean, on-time work
steps.body: A start date you can plan around, with the site cleaned up at the end of each day.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.body: We walk the finished job with you and sort out anything on the list before we call it done.

why.headline: We're not here to rush the job. We're here to do it properly.

themes.title: Remodeling-focused
themes.body: Kitchens, bathrooms and additions are the work, not a side line.

themes.title: Written estimates
themes.body: Scope and price in writing, so you can compare it side by side.

themes.title: Clean & respectful
themes.body: Floors protected, dust contained and the site tidied every day.

themes.title: Direct communication
themes.body: One point of contact who answers your questions as the job goes.

finalCta.headline: Ready to talk about your remodel?
finalCta.body: Send a few details or pick a time that suits you. You'll get a written estimate before anything is booked in.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straightforward conversation about your project.

faq.a: Send the job through the form or call us. We'll ask a few questions, visit if the job needs it, and send a written estimate that lists the scope and price.

faq.q: Which areas around Plano do you cover?
faq.a: Plano, Frisco, Allen, McKinney and Richardson. If you're close by and not on the list, ask anyway.
Ask when you request your estimate and we'll send the licence and insurance details for your job type.

faq.q: How soon can you look at my job?
faq.a: You get a confirmation as soon as you send a request, and we reply to set up a time. If you'd rather book directly, pick a slot in the calendar.

faq.q: What happens after I submit a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to us, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to talk through the job and book a site visit if it needs one.
